notes.md: - **National Strategy for Sustainable Tourism:** launched by the **Ministry of Tourism** in **2022** (June 2022), with the **Responsible Traveller** campaign.
- **India Employment Report 2024:** released in **March 2024** by the **Institute for Human Development (IHD)** with the **ILO**; focus on **youth employment, education and skills**.
- **Census 2011 – highest shares:** **Himachal Pradesh** had the highest share of **cultivators** among workers (**57.9%**); **Bihar** had the highest share of **agricultural labourers** (**52.8%**).
- **1991 crisis – trigger:** the **Gulf War (1990-91)** sharply raised **oil prices** (bigger oil import bill) and cut **remittances** from Indian workers in the Gulf, draining forex reserves.
